note: P3824 (Pro 6:23) — the commandment is a lamp, the teaching a light, the reproofs of discipline the way of life.

dims.v: discipline — its reproofs are the way of life
the discipline whose correcting reproofs form the very road of life
(the lamp and light of the commandment)
the reproofs of discipline as the illumined way

musar (discipline) — 'the reproofs of musar are the way of life'; correction not as burden but as the lit path itself. Discipline valorised as life-giving illumination (cf 6:15 the alternative: broken beyond healing).
